hints.title: Independence of Bridge Choice
hints.text: Notice that connecting node u in tree 1 to node v in tree 2 allows reaching any node in tree 2 within distance k - 1 from v.

hints.title: Tree 2 Optimal Target Count
hints.text: Find the maximum number of nodes within distance k - 1 across all possible anchor nodes in tree 2.

hints.title: Tree 1 Reachability
hints.text: For each node in tree 1, count reachable nodes within distance k and add the optimal tree 2 contribution.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: BFS from each node in tree 1 counts nodes within distance k; BFS in tree 2 finds maximum targets within distance k - 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all n * m bridge edge pairings from scratch takes O(n * m * (n + m)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + m) memory for adjacency representation and BFS queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes the problem into local reachability in tree 1 and optimal bridge entry into tree 2.
